objective: Calibrate the finite-search Dovekie-only IVS profile improvement under Gaussian LCDM mocks with the exact released full STAT+SYS precision and the same bounded search procedure.

null_model.offset_treatment: Added to the mock mean and analytically reprofiled as one unbounded GLS intercept in both model fits.
null_model.covariance: C=P^-1 from the full released 1820x1820 STAT+SYS precision, unpacked in release row order; no separate MUERR diagonal added.
null_model.sampling_transform: For P=L L^T, each mock noise is epsilon=solve(L^T,z), z~N(0,I), so Cov(epsilon)=L^-T L^-1=P^-1=C.

statistic.seed_rule: SeedSequence(master_seed).spawn(200); each child yields one uint64 passed to default_rng.

empirical_finite_search_null_exceedance.interpretation: A coarse fitted-LCDM parametric-null calibration rate for this exact finite search only; not a universal or posterior probability, model evidence, or discovery claim.

IVS.physicality: Positive m, x and E^2 sampled over the observed SN redshift range plus an exact positive baryon/CDM split ceiling and positive interior witness.

search.pool: One 20-process pool across mocks; searches inside each mock serial; numerical-library threads requested=1; no GPU.

independent_review.review_scope_limit: The reviewer audited the sampler, protocol, saved per-mock outputs and accepted-point physicality; this does not prove the global optimality of each finite search or validate full cosmological perturbations.

command: env OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/run_bounded.py --seconds 1470 -- .venv/bin/python work/compute11/dovekie_ivs_null_calibration.py --target 200 --pilot 10 --master-seed 20260925 --cap-seconds 1440
limits: The finite null is conditional on the fitted LCDM shape and common-intercept treatment.
The same finite parameter bounds, grid, multistart budget and local optimizer are repeated; unsearched parameter space is not covered.
The 200-mock interval quantifies Monte Carlo binomial uncertainty only, not model uncertainty or physical-systematic uncertainty.
No BAO, CMB, radiation, perturbations, growth, posterior inference, Bayesian evidence or exact author-modified CAMB reproduction is included.
The physicality checks cover only the observed SN redshift interval and do not calibrate the baryon fraction or prove continuous/global physical viability.
